title: Word families item 7
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: The revised instructions were sufficiently ___ for new volunteers to follow without help.

choice_rationales.A: Clarity is a noun and cannot directly describe instructions after were sufficiently.
choice_rationales.B: Clearly is an adverb, but sufficiently already modifies the describing word needed after were.
choice_rationales.C: Clear is the adjective that describes the instructions and is naturally modified by sufficiently.
choice_rationales.D: Clarify is a verb and cannot serve as the subject complement in this frame.

parts.hint: The linking verb ‘were’ needs a description of the instructions, while sufficiently modifies that description.
parts.correct_explanation: The frame requires an adjective: the instructions ‘were sufficiently clear’.
